notes.title: New Release - My Ex Sister in Law
notes.content:
Hello and thank you for playing Games&Girls!
Did you like the art style? Then maybe you are interested in our new Visual Novel game "My Ex Sister isn Law"
Link to the Steam Page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1892220/My_Ex_Sister_in_Law/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1892220/My_Ex_Sister_in_Law/[/url]

notes.title: Games&Girls Episode 4 Release
notes.content: Games&Girls Episode 4 is out now. Together with a 10% discount in the first week. Episode 1,2 and 3 will also have a week-long discount to celebrate the release. Get it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1133410/GamesGirls_Episode_4/

notes.title: Games&Girls Update for Episode 4
notes.content:
Hello!
It's been a long time since the release of Episode 3. But this will change. Episode 4 will be released soon, so I had to upload Episode 1. The latest update is in preparation for the new episode. You can choose Episode 4 but not play it yet. Just wait a little bit longer ;)

notes.title: Next Episode is coming soon
notes.content: Episode 3 will be released soon. The latest update was in preparation for this. The update also fixes some bugs in Episode 2.
